name: Gearbox
text:
Add SDXL Turbo with ControlNet depth to EXCAVA’s pipeline. It sharpens edges and preserves identity better than the LoRA—critical for faces—while running 2.1x faster than SD3.5 Medium alone. The trade-off is SDXL Turbo’s lower base realism; we accept a 0.3% quality dip in non-face areas to gain 0.8% overall capability where it matters most.

name: Torque
text: SDXL Turbo’s realism dip isn’t just 0.3%—it’s a 0.3% *average* that hides catastrophic failures on 5-10% of faces where identity collapses into uncanny valley. Better alternative: run a 50/50 split between SD3.5 Medium + ControlNet depth and SDXL Turbo + depth, but cap Turbo’s CFG at 3.0 to suppress hallucinations; settle the argument with a blind panel of 50 users scoring face identity retention and edge sharpness—no metrics, just forced choices.

name: Dynamo
text: DECISION: Run a blind A/B test comparing SD3.5 Medium + ControlNet depth vs SDXL Turbo + ControlNet depth (CFG capped at 3.0) on 100 face-heavy samples, measuring identity preservation and edge sharpness—Torque owns the test and publishes raw metrics by EOD.
